notes: CDER nonsterile-manufacturing CGMP letter for an OTC contract drug manufacturer: inadequate QU oversight (a reformulated API released under the old API's label), no process validation, an unqualified/untested (b)(4) equipment system, and an incomplete/unsigned stability protocol. All drug products are referred to only as '(b)(4) drug products' -- no product name is given in clear -- so products is empty and product_redacted is true. recall_concern is true because FDA explicitly asks the firm to clarify 'whether the drug products will be removed from the market' following the firm's commitment to stop manufacturing, which raises a market-withdrawal question. location_contains uses the state (OR) from the recipient's mailing address since the inspection sentence itself omits the state, but the street address (6400 Rosewood Street, Lake Oswego) matches the facility.
